release.description: Change to Central Portal publishing, reproducible builds, dbUnit 3.0.0, GitHub config, convert docs to Asciidoc, version bumps, auto-publish SNAPSHOTS, fix CLI properties not working, fix mvn -X, support replacement tokens, excludes parameter, excludeEmptyTables parameter, export-dtd goal
release.action: Setup reproducible builds.
Change Central artifact publishing from OSSRH to new Portal.
Update dbUnit version to 3.0.0.
Configure GitHub CI.
Convert APT and XDoc doc files to Asciidoc.
Generate and publish Maven site to GitHub pages.
Bump multiple plugin and lib versions.
Update github_actions dependency dependabot/fetch-metadata from 2 to 3 (#2).
Update github_actions dependency actions/upload-pages-artifact from 3 to 5 (#2).
Update github_actions dependency actions/deploy-pages from 4 to 5 (#2).
Auto-publish SNAPSHOTs to Maven Central on master commits.
Update github_actions dependency actions/setup-java from 4 to 5 (#14).
Update maven dependency org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-invoker-plugin from 3.10.0 to 3.10.1 (#13).
Update maven dependency org.slf4j:slf4j-api from 2.0.17 to 2.0.18 (#15).
Update maven dependency org.slf4j:slf4j-simple from 2.0.17 to 2.0.18 (#15).
Update maven dependency org.dbunit:dbunit from 3.0.0 to 3.1.0 (#16).
Fix CLI properties not working: migrate from deprecated Javadoc annotations to Java annotations and add dbunit. property prefix to avoid conflicts with Maven's built-in properties.
Fix mvn -X debug flag not activating dbunit logging: remove slf4j-simple from runtime scope so Maven's own SLF4J provider is used at plugin runtime.
Support replacement tokens by adding replacementDataSetClass parameter to the operation and compare goals.
Convert test assertions from JUnit to AssertJ.
Add excludes parameter to export goal: list of regex patterns to exclude tables from auto-discovered exports.
Add excludeEmptyTables parameter to export goal: skip tables with no rows from auto-discovered exports.
Add export-dtd goal: exports a flat DTD schema from the database with tables ordered by foreign key constraints.
Create composite dataset from multiple source files.
Update dbUnit version to 2.7.3.

release.action: Migrate to Sonatype oss-parent.
Update POMs to make current for release.

Support the generic dbConfig like for ant.
